title: The γ-secretase complex: from discovery to a therapeutic target

γ-Secretase is an intricate intramembrane aspartyl protease that cleaves within the transmembrane domain of ∼150 substrates, plays critical roles in biology and disease, and is considered the ‘proteasome of the membrane’.
